description: Start tracking up to 100 keywords in one call (a list from a spreadsheet, a migration, a new customer's brands): keywords is a list of add_keyword inputs, without reviewSources and feeds (add those afterwards with update_keyword). Each one is created or refused on its own and answered in order in data: status created with the keyword, or failed with error.code (duplicate_keyword: its group already tracks the term; invalid_query, query_needs_one_term, validation_error; not_found: its groupId; insufficient_balance or keyword_limit_reached: the wallet or the 500 ceiling ran out at that keyword, so the rest fail too). When nothing is created and the wallet or the ceiling refused one, the tool fails with that error instead. Each created keyword costs $5 a month and gets its last 30 days at once, like add_keyword. Before the first top-up a call takes at most 10 (funding_required).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

keywords.description: The keywords to create, 1 to 100 (10 before the first top-up), in order. Each is created or refused on its own.

items.description: One keyword, as POST /v1/keywords takes it, without reviewSources and feeds (add those afterwards) or subreddit (follow one with POST /v1/keywords).

anyOf.description: A ceiling on what this keyword may be charged for per day, week or month, mentions and comments together. At the cap it stops matching and receiving comments until the next period starts (UTC), or until the cap is raised or removed. It stays unmuted: it keeps its place and its daily keyword charge; pause it to stop that too.

mentions.description: Charged items allowed per period (see per): matched mentions plus the thread comments delivered under them. Every match counts, relevant or not, the look-back a new keyword gets included, because every match bills.

per.description: The period the cap counts in, in UTC: day, week (from Monday) or calendar month (the default). At the cap the keyword stops until the next period starts.

cap.description: A mention cap per day, week or month (per, default month); omit or null for none.

comments.description: Comments under this keyword's mentions; omitted fields are untouched (on create: off, 20 per post).

enabled.description: Read the comments under this keyword's relevant mentions. Each comment delivered costs $0.008; comments under three words are dropped, never billed. See [Comments](/guides/comments).

maxPerPost.description: The newest comments of one thread you receive: the ceiling on what one mention's comments can cost. A comment naming the keyword is a mention only among these.

anyOf.description: A sentence the classifier reads for this keyword only, on top of the company profile or group description: what the term means here, what to ignore. "Arc is our browser; ignore the geometry word." Null clears it.

context.description: A sentence the classifier reads for this keyword only, on top of the company profile or group description: what the term means here, what to ignore. "Arc is our browser; ignore the geometry word." Null clears it.

display.description: Which of this keyword's mentions you see, by language and country; each list is replaced when sent, kept when omitted. Hidden mentions are still billed.

countries.description: By where the author is (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); omitted: untouched.

languages.description: By the language of the post (ISO 639-1); omitted: untouched.

groupId.description: The group to track it in (grp_...); omit for the workspace's default group. A term may be tracked once per group.

kind.description: brand: your own names. competitor: theirs. topic: the space. Drives share of voice and segments.

matching.description: Omitted fields are untouched; an empty list clears one.

caseSensitive.description: true: the term must appear in the case it was typed (RAG, never rag). Default false.

exactPhrase.description: true: only the exact phrase matches (a term sent in double quotes sets it). false: a multi-word keyword also matches its words close together, kept and billed only when scored relevant. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#the-exact-phrase-only).

excludedAuthors.description: Posts by these authors are dropped: profile or post links, @handles, u/names, Bluesky DIDs or display names, stored in canonical form like an alert's muted list.

excludedTerms.description: A post containing any of these is dropped. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (beta.* matches beta.0.1; *bot matches nightlybot).

onlyAuthors.description: When non-empty, only posts BY these accounts match, in the forms excludedAuthors takes; a Bluesky handle is stored with its DID. Reviews and comments read under a mention are exempt.

repositories.description: GitHub only: each field is replaced when sent, kept when omitted; null clears a minimum.

events.description:
The repository events this keyword takes (default traction, stars, growth; empty: none). See [GitHub](/platforms/github#repositories).

- traction: under 30 days old, it reached 10 stars.
- stars: it passed a milestone (100, 250, 500, 1,000 ...).
- growth: it gained stars fast in a week.
- new: every repository created; opt in, mostly noise.

minStars.description: Only repositories with at least this many stars; null for no minimum.

minWeeklyStars.description: Only repositories that gained at least this many stars in the last 7 days, for every event; an unknown week fails. null: growth needs 100 stars and 20% a week, other events nothing.

requiredGroups.description: Combinations: the post must ALSO contain every term of at least one group (an OR of ANDs), on top of requiredTerms, with the same phrase and wildcard rules. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#several-searches-in-one-keyword).

requiredMode.description: any: at least one required term must appear. all: every one must.

requiredTerms.description: The post must ALSO contain these terms, any one of them or all of them per requiredMode. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (alert* matches alerts and alerting). Empty: no requirement.

subreddits.description: Reddit only, for this keyword alone: each list is replaced when sent, kept when omitted.

excluded.description: Replaces the keyword's deny list; [] clears it.

only.description: Replaces the keyword's allowlist; [] clears it.

termIn.description:
Where the term must appear, any part listed; empty: anywhere; reviews are exempt. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#where-the-term-must-appear).

- title: the post's title (none on X, Bluesky or LinkedIn).
- body: the text after the title.
- url: the post's link.
- author: the author's name or handle.

platforms.description: Platforms to search the term on; omit or null for every platform. [] searches it nowhere: a keyword that only collects reviews or reads feeds, which then needs reviewSources or feeds. Not with `subreddit` (its platform is Reddit).

query.description:
The keyword as one boolean query instead of term and matching, like "acme cloud" AND (pricing OR price*) -jobs ([Keywords](/guides/keywords#write-it-as-a-query)):

- Phrases, words, AND, OR, NOT or -word, parentheses, word-end *
- Compiled into term and the term rules; never sent with them (400).
- Each alternative starts with the term; else 400 query_needs_one_term.

readsWorkspaceFeeds.description: Whether the keyword also reads the workspace's feeds (GET /v1/feeds); default true. A new keyword reading them gets the look-back of the 8 most recently connected.

term.description: The word or phrase to track, case-insensitive; send exactly one of term, `query` and `subreddit`. A multi-word term also matches its words close together (see matching.exactPhrase); double quotes mean the exact phrase only.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: add_keywords
title: Add keywords
